messages.author: c23d8cd4cd856acd
messages.subject: org.renjin.eval.EvalException: object 'C_logit_link' not found
parts:
Hi there,

I'm using Renjin_script engine via Java Scripting to get glm() work in Java. Sample code: 
engine.eval("glmres<-glm(y~age+income+sex,family=binomial(link='logit'))");

track info:
Exception in thread "main" org.renjin.eval.EvalException: object 'C_logit_link' not found
at org.renjin.eval.Context.evaluateSymbol(Context.java:235)

Any idea? Thanks in advance.

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: org.renjin.eval.EvalException: object 'C_logit_link' not found
parts:
This references C code from the stats package that is not yet included in renjin's build. You can try copying the relevant source from  http://svn.r-project.org/R/tags/R-2-14-2/src/library/stats/src/loglin.c

to packages/stats/src/main/c

though you may also have to tinker with gcc-bridge to get it compiling.

Otherwise filing a bug report with the attached code would be very helpful!

Best,
Alex

messages.subject: Re: org.renjin.eval.EvalException: object 'C_logit_link' not found
parts:
Hey Carl,
Just to reply on the mailing list, the problem below can be worked around with a minor tweak to the C source:
https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin/commit/982b62c892b36b6762ea3c1489623bf57f826f93

But the test case you added (thanks!) *also* requires a function called logit_link which uses the .Call interface which is something we're actively working on:

https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin/issues/118

Best,
Alex
